purpose: Archived version history. Player-friendly release notes are available in the patchnotes folder and in the launcher.

releases.name: Unova Together 1.0.20 — Mega Serperior battle fix
releases.body: Mega Serperior now keeps its form and stats through battle, then returns to normal when the battle ends.

releases.name: Unova Together 1.0.19 — Fix for a Windows startup problem
releases.body: Fixed a Windows issue that could prevent the game from opening. Close the emulator before updating, then start it again from the launcher.

releases.name: Unova Together 1.0.18 — Mega Serperior update
releases.body: Continue using Serperiorite to Mega Evolve Serperior during battle. Press L+R together while choosing a move.

releases.name: Unova Together 1.0.17 — Mega Serperior in battle
releases.body: Mega Serperior and Serperiorite are available in supported Black 2 Redux v1.4.1 games. Hold L+R together while choosing a move to Mega Evolve.

releases.name: Unova Together 1.0.16 — Mega Serperior preview
releases.body: Mega Serperior’s battle form and stats are available in this preview. Give it Serperiorite and hold L+R together while choosing a move.

releases.name: Unova Together 1.0.15 — Mega Serperior arrives
releases.body: Mega Evolve Serperior in supported English Black 2 Redux v1.4.1 games. Give it Serperiorite, then hold L+R together while choosing a move in battle.

releases.name: Unova Together 1.0.14 — Smoother LAN hosting
releases.body: Hosting a local game now handles several network events more smoothly.

releases.name: Unova Together 1.0.13 — Safer game updates
releases.body: Updates install beside your current game, so you can finish playing before switching. Your ROMs, saves, and settings stay in place.

releases.name: Unova Together 1.0.10 — Smoother Pokémon followers
releases.body: Followers move more smoothly, stay visible through brief connection hiccups, and update when your party or area changes. Shiny followers use the odds from your game.

releases.name: Unova Together 1.0.9 — Repair older launcher shortcuts
releases.body: Use Repair-Launcher.exe once if an older desktop shortcut still opens an outdated launcher. Your game profiles, saves, and backups stay in place.

releases.name: Unova Together 1.0.8 — Smoother launcher updates
releases.body: After an update, the launcher opens the new game version. Older shortcuts can also open the latest launcher without changing your saves or settings.

releases.name: Unova Together 1.0.7 — Trainer search and a flight shortcut
releases.body: Find practice trainers by name or class before starting a battle that does not change story progress. The Fly shortcut opens the game’s usual party menu and destinations.

releases.name: Unova Together 1.0.6 — Spend time with your companion
releases.body: Talk to, pet, praise, and play with your lead Pokémon. Face it and press R+A, or tap its sprite, to open the interaction menu.

releases.name: Pokemon Together mod library launcher
releases.body:
Pokemon Together now opens a shared mod library on every launch, with separate
Unova and Pokemon X pages. The idle status line is blank and copy is shortened.

Extract the Windows launcher overlay into your existing Unova Together folder and
run Start Pokemon Together.cmd. Unova's runtime, saves and update policy stay with
Unova. Pokemon X requires its separately prepared prototype; its gameplay has not
been rebuilt yet. ROMs, saves, firmware and room credentials are excluded.

Validation: 29 UI/routing tests, frozen launcher self-test, SHA-256 verified package,
ZIP integrity, minimum-window keyboard checks, and strict frontend design audit.
Matching launcher source and checksums are included. Original Unova contributions
are by mvq1303 / WhatWasMissing, with upstream credits and licenses preserved.

releases.name: Unova Together 1.0.5 — Balanced solo experience
releases.body: The extra experience earned in solo battles has been adjusted for a steadier pace.

releases.name: Unova Together 1.0.4 — Free up storage safely
releases.body: Remove unused older game copies from the launcher to make room. Your active game, saves, backups, ROMs, and custom files are kept.

releases.name: Unova Together 1.0.3 — Manage saves with ease
releases.body: Create separate game slots, back up or restore saves, and use the experience calculator to plan solo battles.

releases.name: Unova Together 1.0.2 — A boost for solo battles
releases.body: Solo battles award extra experience to help your team progress while playing alone.

releases.name: Unova Together 1.0.1 — More reliable co-op
releases.body: Reconnect more easily and get clearer connection messages and retry options from the launcher.

releases.name: Unova Together 1.0.0 — Unova Together is here
releases.body:
Explore alongside friends, see nearby teammates, trade eligible items and Pokémon, and join supported trainer battles.

The launcher includes Pokémon followers, companion interactions, Pokémon tools, save backups, updates, and optional battle scenery.

releases.name: Unova Together 0.4.0 — Companion interactions and flight
releases.body: Talk to, pet, praise, and play with your lead Pokémon. An optional flight preview is also available. Companion interactions are for fun and do not change your save.

releases.name: Unova Together 0.3.13 — Quicker menus and reconnects
releases.body: Switch between Players, Pokémon, Co-op, and Settings with the tabs or L/R. The Options shortcut and reconnect controls are easier to use.

releases.name: Unova Together 0.3.12 — Easier co-op tools
releases.body: Find Pokémon tools, co-op settings, and game options more easily. Choose solo or co-op trainer battles, start practice rematches without story rewards, and see clearer teammate status.

releases.name: Unova Together 0.3.11 — More Pokémon tools
releases.body: Look up nearby wild encounters by season, relearn eligible level-up moves, and use supported field HMs without using a battle move slot.

releases.name: Unova Together 0.3.10 — Followers and party stats
releases.body: All 649 base Pokémon can follow you with a gentle idle animation. Check your Pokémon’s IVs and EVs from the launcher.

releases.name: Unova Together 0.3.9 — Battle scenery and better followers
releases.body: Choose optional battle scenery based on your own game files, enjoy updated follower sprites and movement, and use the in-game Options shortcut.

releases.name: Unova Together 0.3.8 — Bigger LAN sessions
releases.body:
Host local sessions with up to 16 players, and let guests join after the host starts.

Co-op invitations and reconnecting are clearer. Traded Pokémon follow the game’s obedience rules in supported Redux versions.

releases.name: Unova Together 0.3.7 — More reliable player tracking
releases.body: Teammate locations and battle status now recover more reliably after menus and battles. The player list better reflects which area each person is visiting.

releases.name: Unova Together 0.3.6 — Clearer teammate locations
releases.body: See teammate locations and battle status more clearly. The player list explains when a teammate’s location is unavailable.

releases.name: Unova Together 0.3.5 — Easy setup and co-op
releases.body:
Set up Unova Together, host or join a local game, and reconnect from the launcher.

Find controls, optional music, and setup guides in one place. Your ROM and save stay on your computer when you update.
